title: CLI Configuration Schema
description: Schema for validating CLI behavior configuration of the FHNLab application.

app_name.description: Name of the application used in CLI output, logs, and help messages.

version_check.description: Whether to check application and configuration version compatibility on startup.

use_colors.description: Enable or disable colored output in the terminal.

show_progress.description: Whether to display progress bars or progress indicators during long-running operations.

interactive.description: Enable interactive CLI behavior such as prompts and confirmations.

confirm_destructive_actions.description: Require confirmation before performing destructive or irreversible actions.

default_profile.description: Name of the default execution profile used when none is explicitly provided.

default_experiments_path.description: Default path where experiment configurations are located.

default_configs_path.description: Root directory containing configuration files such as profiles, database, logging, etc.

format.description: Output format used by the CLI.

float_precision.description: Number of decimal places used when displaying floating-point numbers.

truncate_long_values.description: Whether to truncate long values (paths, arrays, matrices) in CLI output.

errors.description: Configuration related to error handling and diagnostics.

show_traceback.description: Whether to display full Python traceback when an error occurs.

suggest_fixes.description: Whether the CLI should attempt to suggest fixes or corrective actions when errors occur.
